items.subject: A small outback cemetery of plain headstones and iron crosses, an elderly Spanish-Australian woman around 60, slight build, in a faded cotton dress, seen from behind
items.action: She stands still among long rows of weathered graves of former miners and residents
items.gaze_interaction: Her back to camera, head bowed toward the nearest grave, shoulders drawn in
items.setting: Remote Western Australian town cemetery on red earth, 1989, spinifex between the plots
items.color_palette: Red earth, ochre, sun-bleached grey stone, pale dusty blue sky
items.props_detail: A small jar of dried wildflowers at the foot of a weathered headstone
items.lens_technique: deep depth of field, rows receding to the horizon
items.lighting: soft low golden hour light, long gentle shadows
items.mood: Still air, a lone small figure among endless rows, warm fading light
items.narration_anchor: En mil novecientos ochenta y nueve ya habían muerto más de quinientos antiguos trabajadores y residentes de Wittenoom.

items.subject: Former Wittenoom workers and residents, Anglo-Australian and Spanish and Italian migrant men and women in their 40s to 60s, thin builds, seen mostly from behind
items.action: They sit together on folding chairs at a founding meeting, some leaning forward, one older man standing to speak
items.gaze_interaction: Rows of backs facing a trestle table at the front; the standing man, a gaunt Spanish migrant around 55, turned toward the room
items.setting: Plain suburban community hall in Perth, 1979, fibro walls, louvred windows
items.color_palette: Faded cream walls, brown linoleum, mustard and olive 1970s clothing
items.props_detail: A kettle and stacked cups on a side table beside a handwritten attendance sheet
items.camera_angle: slightly high angle from the back of the hall
items.lighting: soft afternoon daylight through louvred windows
items.mood: Hunched shoulders, people seated close together, calm warm light filling the hall
items.narration_anchor: Los que seguían vivos se habían juntado diez años antes en la Asbestos Diseases Society of Australia.

items.subject: An Anglo-Australian judge in his 60s in wig and red robe at the bench, a gallery of elderly former miners, Anglo and Southern European, seen from behind
items.action: The judge reads the verdict aloud from typed pages while the gallery sits motionless
items.gaze_interaction: Judge's head lowered to his pages; gallery backs straight, heads turned toward the bench
items.setting: Western Australian Supreme Court courtroom, 1988, dark jarrah wood panelling, high ceiling
items.color_palette: Deep jarrah brown, crimson robe, muted grey suits, warm amber wood
items.props_detail: A thick bound bundle of evidence resting on the bar table
items.camera_angle: eye-level from the rear of the public gallery
items.lighting: soft diffuse daylight from tall windows
items.mood: Rigid upright backs, a hush across the wooden room, even quiet light
items.narration_anchor: En mil novecientos ochenta y ocho un juez leyó su veredicto: la compañía había mostrado un desprecio continuo, consciente y contumaz por la seguridad y la salud de sus trabajadores.

items.subject: A Spanish-Australian woman in her 60s, slim, grey hair tied back, in a hospital gown
items.action: She lies on the scanner table as it slides her slowly into the ring of a CT scanner
items.gaze_interaction: Eyes toward the ceiling, arms resting at her sides, chest rising shallowly
items.setting: Hospital imaging room in Perth, bare beige walls, a technician's window in the background
items.color_palette: Clinical white, pale institutional green, soft beige
items.props_detail: A folded thin hospital blanket over her legs
items.lighting: soft diffuse daylight mixed with even overhead light
items.mood: A small body inside a large pale machine, quiet even light
items.narration_anchor: Mercedes de Juan, que se quedó en Australia, entra en un escáner y después sopla en un tubo.

items.subject: The same Spanish-Australian woman in her 60s, slim, grey hair, cardigan over a blouse, seated
items.action: She blows hard into a lung function tube connected to a spirometer
items.gaze_interaction: Seen in profile, shoulders hunched forward, body straining with the exhale, a respiratory technician beside her
items.setting: Small hospital lung function lab, beige walls, a window onto eucalyptus trees
items.color_palette: Soft beige, pale green, white, muted cardigan blue
items.props_detail: A cardboard mouthpiece on the spirometer hose
items.mood: Hunched shoulders, a long effortful breath, calm gentle light
items.narration_anchor: «Nos hacen un escáner y una prueba de función pulmonar», dice Mercedes.

items.subject: Blue asbestos tailings on red earth
items.action: Loose fibres lift and drift in a faint breeze across the ground
items.gaze_interaction: Focal direction on fine fibres catching the light
items.setting: Abandoned Wittenoom ground, red Pilbara earth
items.color_palette: Blue-grey fibres against rust red and ochre
items.props_detail: A single strand of fibre glinting in the backlight
items.lens_technique: macro lens, shallow depth of field
items.mood: Glinting fibres suspended in warm still air
items.narration_anchor: Las fibras pueden causar mesotelioma, asbestosis y cáncer de pulmón.

items.subject: Archive shelves of the asbestos victims' society office
items.action: Hundreds of patient files and folders fill the shelves floor to ceiling, newer boxes stacked on the floor
items.gaze_interaction: Focal direction along the aisle of overflowing shelves
items.setting: Cramped advocacy office in Perth, steel shelving, fibro walls
items.color_palette: Manila brown folders, grey steel, faded cream walls
items.props_detail: An open cardboard box of fresh files waiting on the floor
items.lighting: soft daylight from a single window at the end of the aisle
items.mood: Shelves crowding the frame, quiet dust motes in soft light
items.narration_anchor: La cuenta oficial se detuvo. «El gobierno dejó de contar en 2.000, pero ahora se calcula que la cifra puede ser superior a los 4.000.

items.subject: Middle-aged Anglo-Australian adults in their 40s and 50s, sons and daughters of town police and teachers, seen mostly from behind; one thin man around 50 in a checked shirt visible in profile
items.action: They wait seated along a clinic corridor bench; the thin man coughs into a handkerchief
items.gaze_interaction: Most heads lowered; the thin man bent forward, elbows on knees
items.setting: Respiratory clinic waiting area in Perth, plain painted walls, wooden bench
items.color_palette: Pale green walls, beige floor, faded blue and khaki clothing
items.props_detail: A brown envelope of chest x-rays on the bench
items.lighting: soft overcast daylight through frosted glass
items.mood: Bowed heads, bodies folded forward, flat gentle light
items.narration_anchor: Y sigue aumentando», dice Melita Markey. Están enfermando hijos de policías y de maestros que trabajaron en el pueblo.

items.subject: The abandoned town of Wittenoom
items.action: The deserted town lies silent, streets emptied, lots cleared by demolition
items.gaze_interaction: Focal direction across the town toward the gorge ranges
items.setting: Red Pilbara desert, Hamersley Range behind, later abandoned state
items.color_palette: Red earth, ochre, weathered grey, hints of blue tailings, dusty blue sky
items.props_detail: A lone bent street lamp along an empty road
items.lighting: soft late afternoon light, long shadows
items.mood: Vast emptiness, warm quiet light settling over silent streets
items.narration_anchor: Mientras los enfermos se contaban a sí mismos, el Estado decidió qué hacer con el pueblo: borrarlo.

items.subject: Road crew of Anglo-Australian men in their 40s and 50s, sturdy builds, faded work shirts and wide-brimmed hats, seen from behind
items.action: They unbolt and remove the town name panel from a green highway sign, leaving it blank
items.gaze_interaction: Backs to camera, arms raised to the sign, heads tilted up
items.setting: Remote desert highway turnoff in the Pilbara, 2007, red gravel shoulder, spinifex
items.color_palette: Faded highway green, red earth, ochre, dusty blue sky
items.props_detail: The removed name panel leaning face-down against a work truck tyre
items.mood: Small figures under an empty sky, a blank sign in warm calm light
items.narration_anchor: Junio de dos mil siete; otras fuentes dicen dos mil seis. Wittenoom es abolido formalmente. Le quitan el nombre a las señales de la carretera y lo sacan de los mapas.

items.subject: A folded state newspaper reporting the abolition of the town
items.action: The newspaper rests on a dusty roadhouse counter, front page turned up
items.gaze_interaction: Focal direction on the front-page headline
items.setting: Outback roadhouse in the Pilbara, 2007, worn laminate counter, fly screen door
items.color_palette: Newsprint grey, red dust, faded laminate, warm brown
items.props_detail: A chipped enamel mug beside the paper
items.lighting: soft afternoon light through a fly screen
items.mood: Settled dust on the paper, quiet warm light
items.narration_anchor: El gobierno de Australia Occidental habla de «el fin de un período oscuro en la historia de nuestro Estado».

items.subject: Parliament House of Western Australia
items.action: The stately building stands closed and quiet at day's end
items.gaze_interaction: Focal direction up the front steps to the columned facade
items.setting: Perth, 1992, manicured lawns and palm-lined approach
items.color_palette: Sandstone cream, soft green lawns, dusky blue sky
items.props_detail: A single lit window on an upper floor
items.lighting: soft dusk light, warm glow fading
items.mood: Empty steps, closed doors, calm evening light
items.narration_anchor: Quince años antes, en mil novecientos noventa y dos, una investigación parlamentaria había recomendado limpiar los relaves. El gobierno rechazó esas recomendaciones.

items.subject: Blue asbestos tailings heaped in Wittenoom Gorge
items.action: The dumps spill down the gorge floor beneath red cliffs, untouched
items.gaze_interaction: Focal direction along the gorge toward the old mine site
items.setting: Wittenoom Gorge, red banded iron cliffs, dry creek bed
items.color_palette: Blue-grey tailings against rust red cliffs and ochre
items.props_detail: A rusted ore chute jutting from the cliff above the dumps
items.camera_angle: high angle from the gorge rim
items.lighting: soft late afternoon light raking the cliffs
items.mood: Immense scarred slopes, silent gorge in warm light
items.narration_anchor: «La minería en los desfiladeros ha dejado una contaminación que solo puede describirse como vergonzosa, incluso para los estándares de la época», dijo Larry Graham.

items.subject: Pale dust carried off the tailings slopes
items.action: Wind lifts a thin dust veil off the slopes and drifts it down the gorge toward the creek pools
items.gaze_interaction: Focal direction following the drifting dust downstream
items.setting: Lower Wittenoom Gorge, creek pools and floodplain, river gums
items.color_palette: Red earth, ochre, green river gums, blue-grey haze
items.props_detail: A still creek pool with fibres along its bank
items.mood: Gentle wind, a drifting haze over calm water
items.narration_anchor: «Tenemos el deber de impedir una mayor dispersión de los relaves de asbesto», dijo Mark Nevill, por los residentes, por los visitantes, por las generaciones futuras.

items.subject: A typed government memo on cleanup cost
items.action: The memo lies on a desk beside a costing sheet, left unsigned
items.gaze_interaction: Focal direction on the typed pages
items.setting: Government office in Perth, 2016, wooden desk, window blinds
items.color_palette: Off-white paper, dark wood, grey office tones
items.props_detail: A heavy fountain pen resting across the costing sheet
items.mood: Quiet office, slatted calm light across still paper
items.narration_anchor: En dos mil dieciséis, los documentos dicen por qué los relaves siguen donde están: no porque no se pueda, sino por lo que cuesta.

items.subject: Blue asbestos tailings dust drifting past a warning barricade
items.action: Dust blows past the barricade across the open land beyond the forbidden zone
items.gaze_interaction: Focal direction past the barrier toward the distant horizon
items.setting: Edge of the Wittenoom forbidden zone, 2023, red desert plain, Hamersley ranges
items.color_palette: Red earth, ochre, weathered white sign, blue-grey haze, dusty blue sky
items.props_detail: A weathered warning sign on the wire barricade
items.mood: Endless open land, haze crossing an empty barrier in warm settled light
items.narration_anchor: En dos mil veintitrés, los estudios del Estado sobre hasta dónde llega la contaminación ya estaban desactualizados. Borraron el nombre del mapa. El polvo no leía mapas.
